Mina / Priyom — notes below to use in the customer reply. Kept it short. I also attached a quick Grafana screenshot showing p95 latency over the last 30 days.

1) Metrics (canonical names):
- inference.request.count (labels: model, region, route)
- inference.request.latency.p50 / .p95 / .p99 (ms; labels: model, region, quantization_profile)
- inference.error.rate (errors / total; labels: error_class)
- cache.hit.rate (per-model)
- node.cpu.utilization, node.gpu.utilization (infra)

2) Collection and sampling:
- We emit high-resolution metrics to Prometheus (job: redwood-inference) at 10s scrape for most metrics.
- Traces and full request payloads are sampled: default 1:10 (10%).
- For procurement or investigation windows, we can enable 100% sampling for a limited period (recommended max 14 days) under a Data Transfer Addendum and signed approval.
- Raw high-frequency metrics are streamed to an internal Kafka topic (redwood.metrics.raw) then aggregated; raw retention: 90 days, aggregated time-series: 13 months.

3) Monitoring & alerting:
- Out of the box alerts: p95 latency > 500ms for 5m, error rate > 1% over 5m, node.gpu.utilization > 95% sustained 10m.
- Alerts fire to Redwoods' PagerDuty and can be mirrored to customer's PagerDuty/Slack via webhook subscription (we provide an integration guide).

4) Customer access:
- We can provide: (a) a read-only Grafana dashboard link (role: viewer) scoped to your account and region; (b) scheduled CSV exports of underlying time-series; (c) a short-term S3 export of raw metrics when 100% sampling is enabled.
- Approval: read-only dashboards are self-serve after an NDA; raw exports / 100% sampling require a signed Data Transfer Addendum and an approved SR (security review).

5) Temporary SLA exception process:
- Ask via your Redwood account executive + procurement desk; include start/end windows and reason (rollout/migration).
- We evaluate operational risk and produce a written exception (amendment to SOW) that documents the adjusted SLOs and mitigation plan.
- For transparency we timestamp the exception in the contract system and include a link to the Grafana report covering the exception window.

If you want, I can also provide the exact PromQL queries we use for the p95 calculation.

-Jonas
Senior Reliability Engineer
